decisions.reason: Having survived its first review, this specialized robot likely met or at least did not clearly fall below aspiration levels, and the firm's R&D base and product-range slack support continued market testing.
As a core automation module close to the firm's established integrated plant offering, management would usually retain it unless results were clearly below aspirations, which is not indicated here.

This newly launched product line still faces early demand uncertainty and some model-level pruning risk, but its strong fit with the firm's machinery portfolio and available organisational slack make overall withdrawal unlikely within a year.

The software strengthens the firm's future-oriented automation and lifecycle-support strategy, so even if early standalone results are mixed, management would likely keep it as a complementary offering unless performance clearly missed aspirations.
